stem: Which of the following correctly describes the Three-Fifths Compromise?

options.label: F
options.text: A portion of the slave population was counted for legislative representation.

options.label: G
options.text: A federal law enforcing the return of fugitive slaves was passed.

options.label: H
options.text: The census bureau was established to help apportion representation.

options.label: J
options.text: The election of senators was delegated to state legislatures.
